Name: Play as Xie Lian - from TGCF Heaven Official's Blessing
Author: acekidprod
Description:
With this mod, you can cosplay as Xie Lian from TGCF/Heaven Official's Blessing!

This mod was made to be played with my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43398][b]San Lang[/b][/url]. Please check it out!

[b][u]Clothes included:[/u][/b]
- a bamboo hat with an animated veil
- a white hanfu robe & corresponding sleeves
- a gold & red prince outfit & corresponding sleeves + the prince hairpiece
- a dark red ghost bride outfit & corresponding sleeves

[b][u]Hairstyles included:[/u][/b]
- Xie Lian's normal canon hairstyle
- a high ponytail
- a half up ponytail
- a high bun
- loose hair
- loose hair but messy
- low ponytail (animated)
- crooked ponytail
- wet hair
- tied back hair
- the ghost bride veil (2 versions)

[b][u]Accessories included:[/u][/b]
- Ruoye (animated)
- red earrings
- a flower crown in pink, blue & dark red version
- a white flower over the ear

Note that nothing is recolorable. [u]It's on purpose! Please don't ask about it.[/u]

The mod also preloads the full outfits into your game, you can select them inside Fashion Sense, there's a wardrobe button on the right, then you go top-right to "Presets" and you'll find it.

You can also type "Xie Lian" into the search bar of the wardrobe and it will show you all the different items available through the mod.

[b][u]The mod is now compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url] ![/u][/b]
-> Use [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url][/b] to pick between the [b]donghua [/b]and the [b]manhua [/b]versions, and you can also go through Farmer Portraits' GMCM options to configure if you want the background image or when the portrait should appear. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43398][b]San Lang[/b][/url]'s events have been written with these portraits in mind!

If you've downloaded this mod before May 2026, please MANUALLY DELETE the mod file before updating!

[b][u]What I want to add later:[/u][/b]
- Qi Rong's lair outfit
- Guoshi outfit
- General Hua outfit
- The hair for the promotional thing where Xie Lian had braided Ruoye into his hair
- Outfits from the manhua illustrations (yep, that dancer outfit!)
- An entire wardrobe to go through all the seasons

And if like me, you want your game to feel more like TGCF in general, I've made a short list of recommandations [url=https://mochipunk.neocities.org/pages/stardewtgcf]here[/url] <3

Credits to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19125]Churpy[/url] & [url=https://blog.naver.com/kkunma_09]Kkunma[/url] for the base hairstyles.
